evidence.title: Maximizing AI Factory Performance per Watt with NVIDIA DSX MaxLPS

summary: NVIDIA unveiled its DSX MaxLPS platform, designed to maximize AI workload efficiency by optimizing performance per watt in data‑center environments. The solution integrates custom silicon, advanced cooling, and software tools to help operators reduce energy costs while scaling AI training and inference.
title: NVIDIA Introduces DSX MaxLPS to Boost AI Compute Performance per Watt
